name: Lanson-BCC
summary: Lanson-BCC produces and sells wines in France and internationally. The company offers its products under the Champagne Lanson, Champagne Chanoine Frères, Champagne Besserat de Bellefon, Champagne Boizel, Champagne De Venoge, Champagne Philipponnat, Maison Burtin, and Champagne Alexandre Bonnet brand names. It distributes its products through mass retail stores, wine stores, gourmet food stores, restaurants, and hotels, as well as through mail-orders. The company was formerly known as Boizel Chanoine Champagne and changed its name to Lanson-BCC in 2010. Lanson-BCC is based in Reims, France.
